question: Approve DRC-4596 as delivered: the asset test enforcing font size rather than contrast?

artifacts.summary: GO. Review found a blocker the offline half could not: the guard's compliant set contained an element rendering at 12.5px, established twice - offline through css_cascade and in headless Chrome through getComputedStyle, the method the criterion itself names - and the criterion had never been attempted by the implementer. Repaired structurally by making the compliant set element-resolved rather than rule-read, with a new test redding when any selector lands on both sides of the floor. That finding also falsified a claim in this PR's own design doc, which said a per-rule census can only understate the set; it can overstate, and the doc now names the mechanism. AC-4's earlier overturn stands: the rule count was the wrong property and the rendered ink is the right one. One residual is filed as DRC-4614 with the 8,873 false-positive figure that rejected the general widening.
